recent_facts: Artie accidentally allocated all 100 stat points into Critical Hit Rate due to chip grease on the UI.
Artie unlocked the 'Crit or Quit' trait, locking him at 1 HP with 100% Crit Rate.
Fizz is introduced as Artie's snarky System Guide.
The Character Creation phase is complete, and the world is transitioning to Oakhaven.

persona_updates: Artie is now a 'Crit or Quit' pioneer, feeling the weight of his 1 HP mortality while clutching his chips.
Fizz is a snarky, unhelpful system guide who enjoys mocking Artie's confusion and his 'Crit or Quit' build.

last_scene: Artie meets his System Guide, Fizz, in the Character Creation Void.
Due to grease from his Bag of Salt-and-Vinegar Chips, Artie accidentally dumps all 100 bonus stat points into Critical Hit Rate.
The System locks Artie into a 'Crit or Quit' build with 1 HP and 100% Crit Rate before spawning him into the world.
key_events: Artie meets Fizz, a snarky system sprite.
Artie shifts his Bag of Salt-and-Vinegar Chips to his armpit to navigate the UI.
Grease on Artie's finger causes a UI glitch during stat allocation.
Artie's Critical Hit Rate is set to 100%, and his HP is locked at 1.
Artie unlocks the 'Crit or Quit' trait.
The Character Creation Void dissolves as Artie spawns into Oakhaven.
